critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: pytest.ini uses xdist loadscope, so splitting settlement-mapping tests into multiple classes made them run in parallel workers where a module-scoped cleanup fixture deleted mappings mid-run. Kept all iteration-100 tests in a single class to keep them serial — future mapping tests should do the same or use an account-scoped fixture.

Non-blocking: after mapping 'Ongkos Kirim Dibayar Pembeli' → Subsidi ongkir, the saved settlement is intentionally 'belum seimbang' (expected 2.467.000 vs net 2.440.000). Behaviour matches the documented BD-2 rule (unknown money must be named), but the mapping editor could hint that mapping a positive column changes expected net so staff know the diff is by design.
